name: New England Gothic
summary: Like other Regional Gothic aesthetics, its popularity resurged during the mid 2010s, with added aspects of liminal space and specifically formatted text posts, but it has origins in Dark Romantic literature of the early 19th century.
description: Like other Regional Gothic aesthetics, its popularity resurged during the mid 2010s, with added aspects of liminal space and specifically formatted text posts, but it has origins in Dark Romantic literature of the early 19th century.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Anti-Calvinism and anti-Puritanism, anti-colonialism, isolation, terrible knowledge, opposition to religious fanaticism, predestination, reticence, dryness.
